welcome.title: Welcome to agent-ic
welcome.body: Build a chat agent that answers your customers, give it your documents and publish it to Telegram or the API.
welcome.reopen: You can reopen the tour any time from Help → Product tour.

offPage.agents: This step is on the Agents page.
offPage.builder: This step is in the agent builder.
offPage.builderNoAgent: This step is in the agent builder. Start an agent from a template first.
offPage.testing: This step is on the Testing page.

agents.title: Agents
agents.body: An agent is a flow graph that answers your customers. Each agent has a live version and a draft you edit.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.body: Keep your prompts in one library. Every change is a new version, so you can compare and go back.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.body: Upload documents or connect Google Drive. Agents use them to answer with your own facts.

channels.title: Channels
channels.body: Connect a Telegram bot or the API so customers can talk to your agent.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: When an agent hands a chat to a person, it lands here. Get alerts in the app, by email or in Telegram from Settings → Notifications.

testing.title: Testing
testing.body: Chat with any agent in the simulator and see the trace of every step it ran.

build.title: Build your first agent
build.body: Start from a ready-made template, or create an empty agent with New agent.

canvas.title: Your flow
canvas.body: This is your flow: triggers at the top, steps below. Click a step to edit it in the inspector.

palette.title: Add steps
palette.body: Drag a step onto the canvas, or click it to add it below the selected step.

guides.title: Guides
guides.body: Every step has a guide with a working example. Open them here or from the info button of a step.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Publishing makes this version live on your channels. Customers keep talking to the live version while you edit the draft.

test.title: Test it
test.body: Chat as a customer and see the trace of each step.

done.title: You're set
done.body: That's the tour. Here is what to do next:

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.description: Click a step to open it in the tour.
